title: ECG Simulator 2.0
summary: ECG Simulator 2.0 connects 3D cardiac anatomy with live twelve-lead ECG. Source 2.0 adds continuous ventricular geometry, leader labels and an IVS cutaway; Source 1.0 remains available for comparison.
problem: How can we connect tissue-level conduction models to interpretable clinical ECG waveforms — including disease states — without hardcoding lead millivolts?
architecture: Physiology packs emit effects → PhysiologicalModel → CyclePlan → shared dipole sampler that drives both 3D heart glow and live 12-lead ECG. Bilingual 中文/English chrome. Scenarios: sinus, conduction block, AF/flutter, VF/flutter, MI.
designPhilosophy: Prefer mechanistic clarity over black-box accuracy; diseases never hardcode waveforms — they alter physiology once, and glow + ECG update together.
implementation: The app remains 2.0 and now includes Source 2.0 and the preserved Source 1.0 model. Source 2.0 provides a continuous ventricular silhouette, readable leader labels, an IVS cutaway and separate selection and electrical feedback. Both models share the existing physiology and twelve-lead monitor; selecting structures or adjusting opacity in Source 1.0 stays within that model. The simulator 1.0 source archive is also retained.
